# Offboarding

- A short knowledge-transfer document: what you were working on, where the data and code live, what's still open.
- Hand off ongoing projects and make sure authorship/contribution is recorded accurately before memories fade.
- Institutional access (accounts, keys, systems) is returned/removed per the [data-security policy](data-management.qmd) — this is routine, not a sign of distrust, and doesn't end an active collaboration or co-authorship.
- An honest exit conversation about what worked and what didn't. This feedback helps this handbook get better over time.
